warnings.claim: This section is prepared in accordance with IFRS S1.
A complete set of sustainability-related financial disclosures presents fairly all sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.
Fair presentation requires disclosure of relevant information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities and faithful representation (complete, neutral and accurate depiction).
To identify sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects, the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B1–B12.
Fair presentation also requires information that is comparable, verifiable, timely and understandable.

Fair presentation requires additional information when compliance with specifically applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards is insufficient for users to understand effects on cash flows, access to finance and cost of capital over short, medium and long term.
The entity discloses material information about sustainability-related risks and opportunities that could reasonably be expected to affect the entity’s prospects.
To identify and disclose material information, the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B13–B37.
The entity’s sustainability-related financial disclosures are for the same reporting entity as the related financial statements.
The entity provides information enabling users to understand connections between items (including between various sustainability-related risks and opportunities affecting prospects).

The entity provides information enabling users to understand connections between disclosures within the sustainability-related financial disclosures (governance, strategy, risk management, metrics and targets).

The entity provides information enabling users to understand connections across sustainability-related financial disclosures and other general purpose financial reports (such as related financial statements).
The entity identifies the financial statements to which the sustainability-related financial disclosures relate.
When currency is specified as the unit of measure in sustainability-related financial disclosures, the entity uses the presentation currency of its related financial statements.
Unless another IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard permits or requires otherwise, the entity provides disclosures about governance, strategy, risk management, and metrics and targets.
In identifying sustainability-related risks and opportunities affecting prospects, the entity applies IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standards.
In addition, the entity refers to and considers the applicability of the disclosure topics in the SASB Standards.

In identifying applicable disclosure requirements for a sustainability-related risk or opportunity, the entity applies the IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard that specifically applies to that risk or opportunity.

In the absence of a specifically applicable IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard, the entity applies judgement to identify information that is relevant to users’ decision-making and faithfully represents the sustainability-related risk or opportunity.
In making that judgement, the entity refers to and considers the applicability of the metrics associated with SASB disclosure topics.

Information required by an IFRS Sustainability Disclosure Standard may be included by cross-reference to another report published by the entity; when cross-referenced, the entity applies IFRS S1 paragraphs B45–B47.
